Text forms and bytes

Source: R/bytes.R
id_format.Rd

id_format() writes identifiers in their canonical text or another text form. id_bytes() returns their bytes, and id_from_bytes() reads them back.

Usage

id_format(x, form = NULL)

id_bytes(x)

id_from_bytes(bytes, format, layout = NULL)

Arguments

x

A zuid vector from id_parse().

form

A text form of the vector's format (see id_formats()), or NULL for the canonical text.

bytes

A raw matrix with one column per element, a list of raw vectors (NULL for a missing element), or one raw vector holding the elements back to back.

format

The format the bytes are in. Required.

layout

For "snowflake" (required) and "scru64" (optional), an id_layout().

Value

id_format(): a character vector. id_bytes(): a raw matrix with the format's width in rows and one column per element, big-endian, with missing elements as columns of zeros listed in the attribute na. id_from_bytes(): a zuid vector.

Details

Every encoding of id_encode() is a form of a UUID too: id_format(x, "base62") is id_encode(id_bytes(x), "base62").

id_from_bytes() has no default format: sixteen bytes are not a UUID until the caller says so.

Examples

x <- id_parse("018f6b1c-2d3e-7a4b-8c5d-6e7f8091a2b3", "uuid")
id_format(x, "urn")
#> [1] "urn:uuid:018f6b1c-2d3e-7a4b-8c5d-6e7f8091a2b3"
id_format(x, "compact")
#> [1] "018f6b1c2d3e7a4b8c5d6e7f8091a2b3"
id_format(x, "base32")
#> [1] "01HXNHRB9YF95RRQBEFY0938NK"
b <- id_bytes(x)
b[, 1]
#>  [1] 01 8f 6b 1c 2d 3e 7a 4b 8c 5d 6e 7f 80 91 a2 b3
id_from_bytes(b, "uuid")
#> <zuid_uuid[1]>
#> [1] 018f6b1c-2d3e-7a4b-8c5d-6e7f8091a2b3
